evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We present ROSTrans, a benchmark for evaluating LLMs on ROS1-to-ROS2 code migration, a representative and practically important setting for ROS code generation.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Although large language models have shown strong capabilities in domain-specific code generation, their performance in robotics software development, especially for the Robot Operating System (ROS), remains largely unexplored.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Evaluating six frontier LLMs over five stochastic generations per task, we find pass@1 below 10.9%, and that 56.5% of all samples build successfully and then fail at runtime,and 32.0% fail runtime assertions on the migrated interfaces, a class of error no compile-only oracle can detect.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测

evidence.label: 给出任务规模或覆盖范围
evidence.excerpt: ROSTrans comprises 108 scaffolded completion tasks drawn from a diverse set of 70+ open-source ROS1 repositories and organized into a hierarchical taxonomy assessing interface-level, behavioral-level and system-level correctness.
